en: A vintage illustrated advertising postcard for an equestrian and saddlery business. The upper left shows a horse pulling a light carriage with two well‑dressed riders. The lower left shows a man saddling a horse. The right half is filled with detailed drawings of saddles, harnesses, bridles, whips, grooming tools, luggage and other horse‑related equipment, with a horse's head mounted on the wall. At the bottom, Dutch text advertises a saddlemaker and carriage upholsterer's shop located in Nijmegen.
